result_notes.lem:internal-truncation: Right Gray internal hom H(Y)=Hom_oplax(D1,Y) is an n-category for finite n targetY; reflection X->tau_nX gives natural bijection of cylinders intoY preserving endpoints/restrictions. Tensor stays in omega-category and may contain dimension n+1 cells. Reflection identifies n-cell boundaries of(n+1)cells; not the q-cell-preserving unique-filler cutoff.
result_notes.lem:gray-nerve: Natural map N_inftyX x Delta1 -> N_infty(X tensor D1), endpoint/counit formulas, yields nerve homotopy; stationary strict functor restricts to constant old-nerve homotopy. Positive Alexander-Whitney diagonal is natural for monotone ordinal maps including degeneracies, not arbitrary chain maps. Right interval convention fixed.
result_notes.lem:filtered: Strict n-categories locally finitely presentable; filtered colimits computed on cells, each reflected finite oriental finitely presentable, Street nerve and finite Ex iterates preserve filtered colimits. Simplicial weak equivalences closed under filtered colimits of arrows without injective transition maps. Finite support/equality witnesses, not finite object cardinality.
result_notes.lem:simplicial-gluing: Map of spans of simplicial sets with three objectwise weak equivalences and ONE SPECIFIED MONOMORPHIC leg in each row gives pushout weak equivalence; ordinary pushouts compute homotopy pushouts. Other attaching leg may be nonmonic. Uses old simplicial left properness/cofibrant undercategories, not unconditional weak-equivalence preservation for arbitrary pushouts.
result_notes.lem:relative-prism: A sieve A in posetE, monotone f<=g, f|A=g|A, g constant on E minusA: positive normalized chain formula [w] tensor u ->[f(w0),...,f(wp),g(wp)] defines strict RIGHT Gray cylinder, stationary relative to common endpoint map on all U(A). Agreement on all chain degrees/degeneracies essential. A zero top chain can be identity on a NONidentity lower cell; top-chain zero alone does not prove full stationarity.

Ob preserves colimits by chaotic-category right adjoint. No assertion arbitrary categorical limits commute with arbitrary fibers.
result_notes.lem:oriental-segments: Initial or final vertex segment I of[m] gives FULL reflected oriental subcategory; endpoints force every atom support into interval, clamp retraction proves injectivity after reflection. Empty case has no cells. Does not claim full subcategory on arbitrary disconnected vertex subset has the same simple face description.

A simplex belongs to sieve containing its last vertex or cosieve containing first vertex. Arbitrary full-object covers without common sieve/cosieve orientation need not cover simplices.

Independent finite greatest-point/prism/sieve-cover proof then filtered colimits. Old known result; proof does not depend on model-structure transfer or couniversality theorem itself.

result_notes.cor:attachment-invariance: For generating boundary/horn pair and ANY attachment a, ifX->Xprime is Street weak equivalence then attachedY->Yprime is. Pushout-of-nerves comparison naturality and a specific monic nerve leg, not arbitrary algebraic attachment invariance.
result_notes.lem:transfinite-horns: Every relative L_nJ-cell map (transfinite composite of pushouts of coproducts) is Street weak equivalence. Well-order simultaneous attachments; at nonzero limit ordinal filtered-colimit arrows have fixed original source. No computable finite termination or work bound.
result_notes.prop:model-structure: Unrestricted model structure with prescribed weak/fibration/cofibration classes, locally presentable and cofibrantly generated by L_nI/J. Regular-kappa all-squares small object argument gives BOTH WFS, actual fixed-source retract and D=(L_nJ)-cof=C_n intersectW_n. Not merely a left semi-model structure on cofibrant sources.

Left proper via generating boundary attachment invariance, transfinite limits and FIXED-SOURCE retract of relative L_nI-cell map; no cofibrancy/fibrancy base restrictions. Old Dwyer maps not assumed closed under arbitrary retracts.
result_notes.prop:subdivided-unit: For EVERY simplicial K, eta_(Sd^2K):Sd^2K ->N_n c_n Sd^2K weak equivalence. Attach boundary simplices allowing noninjective/degenerate old maps, use known poset description only for GENERATING pieces, two specified monic gluing legs and actual canonical unit identity, then filtered limits. Not poset identification for arbitrary K.
result_notes.thm:quillen-equivalence: Composite c_n Sd^2 adjoint Ex^2N_n Quillen equivalence using actual model structure and allK unit. id->Ex weak-equivalence theorem is independently needed; a mate of Sd->id is NOT automatically weak equivalence. result_notes.lem:strict-presentations: For sorted generatorsG and STRONG raw-term equationsR, simultaneous definedness/equality closure with finite inference rules gives small strict n-category P(G,R). Composition guard requires actual boundary equality; interchange all four inner guards; reflexivity ONLY defined terms. Equations can create NEW composable pairs and composites; ordinary quotient of existing cell set insufficient.
result_notes.prop:strict-presentability: All strict positive finite/omega nCat locally small, complete/cocomplete, locally FINITELY presentable; cellwise filtered colimits and common regular bound for any set of objects. Finite strong presentation finitely presentable even if infinitely many cells; countably sorted omega signature is finitary. Arbitrary generators/relations still give only cardinal existence, no effective solver or bounded factorization.
